_source: Written from the documented behaviour of each flag (docker run reference; gVisor user guide: networking, filesystem, compatibility) with the lab's default budgets (cpu 2 s, wall 5 s, memory 256 MiB, file 8 MiB, output 64 KiB/1 MiB).
